notes: Use 'überrascht' to describe someone feeling the effect of something unexpected. It is the past participle of the verb 'überraschen' (to surprise) used as an adjective.
Do not confuse this with 'erstaunt', which often suggests a slightly more intellectual or amazed tone, whereas 'überrascht' is the direct, common way to say you are caught off guard.
